title: Two laboratories
body: Switch between the Model Playground and the Text Lab here. You are in the Playground now.

title: A live neural network
body: Neurons glow as they activate, and connections thicken with their weight.

title: Editing the network
body: Use the − and + controls over any layer to add or remove neurons and layers, or apply a Shallow, Wide, or Deep preset.

title: Training controls
body: Press play to train continuously, or step once to watch a single batch nudge the weights.

title: The decision boundary
body: The decision boundary shows what the model predicts across the whole plane as it learns.

title: The mission card
body: Each mission teaches one idea under a restriction. Hit the target and check your solution.

title: XP and the quest map
body: Completing missions earns XP and unlocks the next quest on your map. Good luck!
